core_obligations: For a representable Z -> Y, note that Z x_Y X -> Z is an immersion of schemes and hence a monomorphism (proof lines 1985-1989).
Conclude that f is representable and a monomorphism (proof lines 1989-1990).
Deduce separatedness of f from monomorphismhood (proof lines 1981-1981).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: an immersion f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S is a monomorphism, and in particular is separated (source lines 1978-1982). The proof checks representability on an arbitrary representable Z -> Y: the base change Z x_Y X -> Z is an immersion of schemes, hence a monomorphism by the scheme statement, and therefore f is representable and a monomorphism of algebraic spaces; separatedness follows because monomorphisms are separated.
